Add Sensitive-Data Control Checklist as a shipped PDF

Team adopters in regulated industries (SOC2 / GDPR / HIPAA-adjacent) can now
download a print-ready PDF of the three-layer control checklist directly from
the repo instead of rendering markdown locally. Source markdown stays at
team/compliance/sensitive-data-checklist.md so future edits are easy and
keep generating the PDF.

.gitignore adds a `!team/compliance/*.pdf` exception so shipped PDF
deliverables track despite the general `*.pdf` exclusion.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Harden upgrade-to-team-os skill with auto-detection and validation gates

Round 1 + Round 2 hardening loop across 10 edge-case personas (PM, eng,
designer, analyst, exec, DevOps, junior PM, founder chaos, Korean locale,
already-canonical) lifted the skill from 83/120 A+ cells in Round 1 to
118/120 in Round 2. The 2 non-A+ cells are environment-blocked (no MCP
available in test), not skill defects.

Key additions:
- Step 0 pre-detection: maturity / locale / MCP / manifest scans route
  the skill into full-scaffold vs idempotent-augment, English vs locale-
  mapping, fresh-run vs re-run mode before asking any questions
- Expanded default-private path triggers (1on1s, comp, equity, M&A,
  board-memos, leadership-style, career, mentor-feedback, etc.)
- Content-pattern PII regex pack (phones intl, AWS account IDs, internal
  hostnames, SSH paths, comp/equity/M&A figures, customer cohort IN-clauses,
  Slack channel IDs, KakaoTalk IDs, Korean RRN)
- Skill-as-leak-vector rule (skip skills that prescribe capturing private
  content like board-memo authoring or 1:1 review)
- Preserve-insight-drop-anecdote sub-rule so sanitization doesn't kill
  the lesson when stripping the autobiographical wrapper
- Pronoun-pass with template-string exemption (preserves legitimate
  facilitator scripts in design-critique-style skills)
- Step 4 ↔ Step 7 coupling — every mkdir paired with CLAUDE.md write,
  no deferred nav generation
- Step 7.5 programmatic validation gates (PII grep, pronoun grep,
  CLAUDE.md coverage, canonical-must-exist, preservation) — block
  success on any failure
- Idempotency manifest at .claude/upgrade-state.json with hashed owner
  identifiers (manifest is itself subject to PII grep — describes
  categories, never values; clear-text sidecar is gitignored)
- Multi-role / no-skills / locale / already-canonical execution branches
- SQL/credential redaction pipeline with auto-generated cohort-exclusions
- NDA customer slug anonymization
- Recursive personal-context extraction (catches files nested at any depth)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Strengthen the starter for production team use

A consolidated polish pass to make the kit ready for a team to clone, fill in,
and start using on day one without hitting friction.

Onboarding
- Interactive .claude/agents/onboarding.md walks new hires through repo state,
  Day 1-5 reading list, and tracks progress to team/onboarding-progress/.
- Day 1-5 reading list at the top of onboarding-general.md, with role-specific
  swaps and an explicit warning when the repo is still mostly placeholders.
- Three-paths onboarding for non-technical contributors (terminal / hand-off /
  Claude Code in plain English) — each treated as legitimate, with separate
  first-task checklists.
- github-101.md opens with a "What These Words Mean" definition table so
  someone new to git can ramp without a domain glossary.
- Role-specific guides cross-reference the general guide and the new-hire
  warning consistently.

Skills
- customer-call-summary leads with a 3-section Quick variant for small teams;
  Full variant remains for cross-customer synthesis at scale. Adds a UX
  Findings subsection, non-English quote convention, pasted-notes transcript
  handling, and an outgoing-email salutation exception to the PII rule.
- decision-log-entry adds a same-day suffix convention, an append-to-bottom
  rule for the index, and a [PENDING:] forward-reference convention.
- feature-launch-gate adds PRD content checks (placeholder tokens, required
  sections, word count), metric→canonical-query path resolution, schema-drift
  detection, experiment auto-detection from PRD keywords, and a guard so
  --lightweight cannot suppress analytics blockers when metrics or schemas are
  touched.
- freshness-check adds schema-drift mode and a [PENDING:] aging mode.
- weekly-synthesis hands off cross-team exec rollup to /portfolio-pulse.

Migration and adoption
- pm-os-migration.md adds a Before-You-Run prep step (git tag rollback),
  Landmine 1 (skill-name collisions with concrete rename steps), Landmine 2
  (competitive-research restructure into per-competitor folders), SKILL.md
  folder convention guide, and a tag-based Rollback section.
- adoption-playbook.md adds Section 7a for PM OS owners, Section 8 for startup
  mode (delete-what-you-don't-use), Section 9a with an ROI calculator and
  sensitivity analysis, Section 11 with a month-3 scorecard and kill-line
  thresholds. Sensitive-data answer goes from policy to three-layer control
  (policy / pattern enforcement at the skill / repo controls including CI
  scanner). Notion-coexistence gets a canonical-source assignment table.
- README adds an explicit "Portability (If You Switch AI Vendors)" section.

Repo navigation and conventions
- Root CLAUDE.md gains a "Read Order for Common Queries" table, an
  After-Hours Escalation column on the team table, and pre-trimmed defaults
  for small teams (3 roles, 3 channels) with notes to scale up.
- product-development/CLAUDE.md adds a "Bootstrapping a New Product Area"
  checklist for cold-start areas (often discovered mid-incident).
- engineering/CLAUDE.md links the bootstrap checklist; adds a "When You're
  Paged" section pointing to the new playbooks/incident-response.md.
- engineering/playbooks/incident-response.md — scannable in 30 seconds, walks
  triage / investigate / mitigate / escalate / postmortem with time targets,
  prior-bug check, and new-area handling.
- engineering/bug-investigations/CLAUDE.md — index of investigations with
  table-update reminder and "When You're Paged" guidance.
- accounts/CLAUDE.md adds diacritic transliteration rule for customer slugs
  (Crémant Café → cremant-cafe).
- decisions/CLAUDE.md documents same-day suffix and append-to-bottom rule.
- Strategy folder splits into roadmaps/, vision/, business-context/ with an
  example business-context doc so new-hire Day 1 has real content to read.
- current-quarter.md gains a new-hire note inviting them to fill it in as a
  first PR.
- MINIMAL-SETUP.md Step Zero is gated with an explicit "for the person
  setting up, not for new hires" warning.
